uncovered_item_details.paper_location: Supplement Fig. S2(a), black branch, PDF p. 9
direct_gap_statements: Supplement Fig. S2(a) requires the magnetic-field-dependent interacting relative-state spectrum, but the paper and supplement provide neither the coupled-channel B-to-energy map nor an equivalent complete interaction calibration.

direct_cause.statement: Supplement Fig. S2(a) requires the magnetic-field-dependent interacting relative-state spectrum, but the paper and supplement provide neither the coupled-channel B-to-energy map nor an equivalent complete interaction calibration.

root_cause.statement: The publication identifies the state sectors and contact-interaction Hamiltonian but omits the indispensable numerical calibration needed to regenerate its paper-exact field-dependent branches; the clean-room implementation can therefore test the mechanism only as a disclosed proxy.

code_fault_assessment.statement: No defect was found in the executable proxy after branch-continuity, zero-crossing, sector-count, symmetry, and source-isolated execution checks; changing the code cannot recover an unpublished B-to-energy calibration.

checks.statement: A full paper-and-supplement trace finds the Hamiltonian and qualitative state selection but no complete coupled-channel field calibration.
Target-specific numerical invariants and the expected sector structure pass for the disclosed proxy implementation.
The spectrum was generated in the isolated runner without paper, source-image, author-code, or author-array access.

next_discriminating_test.action: Obtain an author-supplied coupled-channel B-to-energy table or an equivalently complete published calibration, then rerun the existing paper-scale code path unchanged.
next_discriminating_test.expected_resolution: The supplied calibration would convert the proxy branches into a testable paper-exact spectrum; without it the external boundary is final.

next_discriminating_actions: Obtain an author-supplied coupled-channel B-to-energy table or an equivalently complete published calibration, then rerun the existing paper-scale code path unchanged.

direct_gap_statements: Supplement Fig. S2(b) depends on interaction-dependent quartic expectation values of the field-dependent relative states, which are described procedurally but not numerically specified in the publication.

root_cause.statement: The paper prints the Gaussian potential, fitted waist, perturbative coupling, basis and diagonalization procedure, but omits the interaction-dependent state data required to evaluate the quartic matrix elements paper-exactly across magnetic field.

uncovered_item_details.paper_location: Supplement Fig. S2(c), grayscale, PDF p. 10
direct_gap_statements: Supplement Fig. S2(c) requires the rotating perturbation amplitude beta (or an exactly equivalent target-specific Rabi coupling), but the publication prints only the pulse duration and does not report beta for this calculation.

direct_cause.statement: Supplement Fig. S2(c) requires the rotating perturbation amplitude beta (or an exactly equivalent target-specific Rabi coupling), but the publication prints only the pulse duration and does not report beta for this calculation.

root_cause.statement: The paper defines the time-evolution operator and reports the 350 microsecond duration, but leaves the target-specific drive strength and the underlying field-dependent calibration unpublished, so the grayscale response cannot be regenerated paper-exactly.
